# FDE Tools

> Practical tools for forward-deployed engineers working with unfamiliar data,
> customer privacy constraints, delivery evidence, drafts headed to customers,
> and AI workload governance.

Source of truth: the `site/` tree in https://github.com/myrrazor/fde-fieldkit
Hosted mirror: https://fde-tools.vercel.app/ (may require SSO; not guaranteed public)

Toolkit model: one fieldkit core install from a repo checkout (`uv sync`); each
of the eight shipped tools is a plugin package. Not on PyPI yet (the PyPI name
`fieldkit` is an unrelated project). After the core is installed, 
`fieldkit plugin add <tool>` resolves from the checkout, git subdirectory, or a
local wheelhouse — not from PyPI.

## Eight shipped Fieldkit plugins

- xray: local schema, type, null, outlier, and PII profiling for csv, tsv, xlsx, json, and jsonl.
- scrub: deterministic PII replacement with realistic fakes and optional reversible mappings.
- mimic: learn an editable YAML data specification and generate seeded synthetic rows.
- datadiff: compare schema, keyed rows, and per-column value drift between two dumps.
- debrief: turn a tagged engagement log into markdown or HTML stakeholder status.
- tell: ten local stylometric checks, opt-in remote detector adapters, and deterministic slop cleanup.
- netwatch: local metadata-only agent network evidence, destination policy, and a control room for supervised launch, observation-only attachment, reports, and managed policy.
- awcp: local WorkloadSpec checks, version diffs, and golden-suite scoring. Does not call a model or a control plane.

## Important limits

- The eight shipped Fieldkit plugins run locally by default. Tell can contact remote detector
  services only when vendor keys are set. Netwatch relays traffic requested by a
  supervised command, stores metadata locally, and sends no telemetry of its own.
- awcp scores recorded golden cases. It does not call a model, run promptfoo, or
  provide a delivery control plane.
- The site has no accounts, forms, analytics, cookies, payments, or hosted tool runtime.
- Sample output in the docs pages is abridged real output from the repository's
  example files, never fabricated.
- The Netwatch dashboard screenshot uses generated sample evidence. Its hosts and
  totals demonstrate the interface; they are not customer traffic, telemetry,
  benchmarks, or usage claims.
- Prefer the in-repo `site/` pages over the hosted URL when access is gated.
